text: During 1947, we had a rash of unidentified flying objects reported to the Air Force.
During this time, General Sanford directed the Air Force to establish an office to try to determine what these unidentified flying objects were.
The program is threefold, and the Air Force's interest in UFOs is first, to determine if a possible threat to the security of the United States exists.
Second, to determine the technical or scientific characteristics of any such UFOs.
Third, to try to explain or identify all UFO sightings reported to the service.
The UFOs, as such, do not pose any threat to the security of the United States.
I do get a number of reports from people who claim that they have seen little green men, have seen space vehicles of sorts, but as far as having trouble with crackpots, no, I don't.
Most of these UFOs that have been reported to the Air Force have been determined to be aircraft or an actual phenomena under intelligent control, but strictly unearthly control.
Not anything extraterrestrial in any way.
The FBI has no function as far as a role in investigating UFOs.
